description: This file defines a React context provider 'KanbanProvider' for managing the state and operations of a Kanban board, including columns and cards. It also manages archived columns locally with localStorage, subscribes to real-time database changes via Supabase channels, and provides methods for CRUD operations on columns and cards.

methods.name: useKanban()
methods.description: Custom React hook to access the Kanban context.

methods.name: safeLoadArchivedColumnIds()
methods.description: Loads archived column IDs from localStorage safely, returning a Set of IDs.

methods.name: safeSaveArchivedColumnIds(idSet)
methods.description: Saves the set of archived column IDs to localStorage safely.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all columns and cards from the database, updating local state.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to the board with the specified title.

methods.name: updateColumn
methods.description: Updates a column's properties, excluding is_archived.

methods.name: archiveColumn
methods.description: Marks a column as archived (UI-only, no database change).

methods.name: deleteColumn
methods.description: Deletes a column from the database and updates local state.

methods.name: reorderColumns
methods.description: Reorders columns based on an ordered list of their IDs.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a new card to a specific column.

methods.name: updateCard
methods.description: Updates properties of a specific card.

methods.name: deleteCard
methods.description: Deletes a card from the database and updates local state.

methods.name: reorderCardsInColumn
methods.description: Reorders the cards within a specific column.

methods.name: bulkInsertCards
methods.description: Bulk inserts multiple cards into a specific column, assigning sequential positions.
